# FixIt
> FixIt diagnoses errors in apps built with AI coding tools (Lovable, Bolt, Cursor, Replit, v0) and Supabase. Paste an error, screenshot, or public GitHub repo; get the root cause in plain English, step-by-step fix, and a ready-to-paste prompt for your AI builder.

- Site: https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/
- Pricing: 3 free fixes per email per month; $9 per fix, $29 for 5 fixes, $19/month unlimited.
- Common fixes: Supabase "new row violates row-level security policy" (needs INSERT and, with .select(), SELECT policies), Edge Function CORS / "Failed to fetch", Edge Function 401 Invalid JWT with new API keys (verify_jwt), Netlify/Vercel 404 on refresh, Vite env vars (VITE_ prefix), Replit "Application failed to respond" (bind 0.0.0.0 and PORT), Next.js hydration errors, Stripe webhook signature errors, Supabase "permission denied for table" (42501) on tables created after Oct 30, 2026 (new tables need an explicit GRANT; keep RLS on), PGRST200 "Could not find a relationship" (add a foreign key to public.profiles), AuthSessionMissingError (treat no session as logged out).
- Privacy: never asks for API keys; pasted secrets are redacted and users are told to rotate them; screenshots deleted after analysis.
- Hard cases are escalated to a human.
- Last updated: 2026-10-26. Sitemap: https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/sitemap.xml

## Error Encyclopedia
Index: https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/
- [Error: listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use :::3000](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/eaddrinuse-address-already-in-use) (Node.js (Cursor, local dev)): Your server tried to start on port 3000 but something is already using it, often an old copy of the same dev server that never shut down.
- [TypeError: Failed to fetch dynamically imported module](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/failed-to-fetch-dynamically-imported-module) (Vite (Lovable, Bolt, v0)): The browser tried to load a lazy-loaded JavaScript chunk that no longer exists.
- [Mixed Content: The page was loaded over HTTPS, but requested an insecure resource](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/mixed-content-blocked) (Browser (Vercel, Netlify, Lovable)): Your live site is HTTPS, but it is calling an API, image or script over plain http://.
- [Deploy directory 'dist' does not exist](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/netlify-deploy-directory-does-not-exist) (Netlify): The build finished (or was skipped) but Netlify can't find the folder it's supposed to publish.
- [Netlify "Page not found" when refreshing or opening a direct link](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/netlify-page-not-found-on-refresh) (Netlify): Your React/Vite single-page app works when you click around, but reloading /dashboard or opening a shared link shows Netlify's 'Page not found'.
- [Error: Dynamic server usage: Route couldn't be rendered statically because it used cookies](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/nextjs-dynamic-server-usage) (Next.js (v0, Vercel)): During next build, Next.js tried to pre-render a page as static HTML, but the code reads per-request data (cookies(), headers(), searchParams), which only exist at request time.
- [npm ERR! ERESOLVE unable to resolve dependency tree](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/npm-eresolve-unable-to-resolve-dependency-tree) (npm (Bolt, Cursor, Vercel, Netlify)): npm refused to install because two packages need incompatible versions of the same peer dependency, usually React.
- [JSON object requested, multiple (or no) rows returned](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/postgrest-pgrst116-multiple-or-no-rows) (Supabase): You called .single() and the query returned zero rows or more than one (PostgREST code PGRST116).
- [ReferenceError: process is not defined](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/process-is-not-defined-vite) (Vite (Lovable, Bolt)): Browser code tried to use process.env, which only exists in Node.
- [Replit deployment failed: your app is not responding on the expected port (health check failed)](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/replit-deployment-failed-health-checks) (Replit): Replit started your app but could not reach it over HTTP in time, so the deployment was marked failed.
- [Invalid API Key provided: sk_test_****](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/stripe-invalid-api-key-provided) (Stripe): Stripe rejected the secret key your server sent.
- [No signatures found matching the expected signature for payload](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/stripe-no-signatures-found-matching-payload) (Stripe): Stripe's library could not verify that the webhook really came from Stripe.
- [StripeInvalidRequestError: No such price: 'price_...'](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/stripe-no-such-price) (Stripe): Stripe can't find that price ID with the API key you used.
- [Supabase magic link / confirm email redirects to localhost:3000](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-auth-redirects-to-localhost) (Supabase): The email link sends users to http://localhost:3000, which only exists on your own computer, so they see 'This site can't be reached'.
- [AuthSessionMissingError: Auth session missing!](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-auth-session-missing) (Supabase): Your code asked Supabase for the signed-in user (getUser, updateUser, signOut) but there is no session at that moment.
- [Could not find the 'column' column of 'table' in the schema cache](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-could-not-find-column-in-schema-cache) (Supabase): The Supabase REST API (PostgREST, code PGRST204) does not know about a column your insert or update sends.
- [Access to fetch at 'https://<project>.supabase.co/functions/v1/...' has been blocked by CORS policy](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-edge-function-cors-error) (Supabase): Your browser asked the Supabase Edge Function for permission to call it (a preflight OPTIONS request), and the function didn't answer with the right CORS headers.
- [FunctionsHttpError: Edge Function returned a non-2xx status code](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-edge-function-non-2xx-status) (Supabase): Your Supabase Edge Function ran (or tried to) and answered with an error status like 400, 401 or 500.
- [AuthApiError: Email not confirmed](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-email-not-confirmed) (Supabase): The account exists but Supabase requires the user to click the confirmation link before signing in, and they have not yet (or the email never arrived).
- [AuthApiError: email rate limit exceeded](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-email-rate-limit-exceeded) (Supabase): Supabase stopped sending auth emails (signup confirmation, magic links, password resets) because the project hit its hourly email limit.
- [infinite recursion detected in policy for relation](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-infinite-recursion-in-policy) (Supabase): An RLS policy on a table queries the same table (directly or through another table whose policy points back), so Postgres would loop forever checking it, and it stops with error 42P17.
- [AuthApiError: Invalid Refresh Token: Refresh Token Not Found](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-invalid-refresh-token-not-found) (Supabase): The browser had a saved Supabase session, but the refresh token in it is no longer valid on the server, so Supabase cannot renew the session.
- [JWT expired](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-jwt-expired) (Supabase): Supabase rejected the request because the access token your app sent is past its expiry time (1 hour by default).
- [new row violates row-level security policy for table](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-new-row-violates-row-level-security-policy) (Supabase): Supabase blocked an insert or update because Row Level Security (RLS) is on for that table and no policy allows this user to write this row.
- [permission denied for table](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-permission-denied-for-table) (Supabase): Postgres (error code 42501) refused access before row-level security was even checked.
- [Could not find a relationship between 'posts' and 'profiles' in the schema cache](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-pgrst200-relationship-not-found) (Supabase): Your query asks Supabase to join two tables in one request (for example `select('*, profiles(username)')`), but the Supabase REST API (PostgREST, error code PGRST200) can't find a foreign key linking them.
- [relation "public.table" does not exist](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-relation-does-not-exist) (Supabase): Postgres (42P01) cannot find a table with that name.
- [StorageApiError: Bucket not found](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/supabase-storage-bucket-not-found) (Supabase): Supabase Storage cannot find a bucket with the name in your code, or the current user is not allowed to see it.
- [404: NOT_FOUND on Vercel after refreshing a page (Vite / React SPA)](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/vercel-404-not-found-on-refresh) (Vercel): Vercel serves your built files, but /settings is a client-side route with no file behind it, so a refresh or direct link returns Vercel's 404: NOT_FOUND page.
- [504: GATEWAY_TIMEOUT FUNCTION_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT](https://fixitbot.pythonanywhere.com/errors/vercel-function-invocation-timeout) (Vercel): Your Vercel serverless function (an API route or server action) ran longer than its maximum duration, so Vercel killed it and returned a 504.
